concepts.name: 01-pearl-glass
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity native macOS product design exploration for Vale, a tiny keyboard-shortcut assistant that lives at the top-right beside the user's work. This is an actual compact utility concept, not a landing page, full chat app, browser app or dashboard. Native SF Pro-like system typography and SF Symbols-like delicate monochrome icons. Original design interpreting restrained Refero/Linear spacing and hierarchy and Apple's Liquid Glass materials; no copied branding. Quiet glass, softly refracted edges, restrained specular rim, precise shadows and strongly legible text. Absolutely no neon, luminous orb, heavy rainbow gradients, 3D mockup, oversized controls, hero headings, chat-history sidebar, dock, traffic-light titlebar or extra detached assistant window. The assistant is ONE continuous panel that changes height in place and remains right/top anchored; small 300x45pt at rest, 320-340pt wide while expanded. Context is explicitly selected, not ambient surveillance. A plus handles screenshots/files, microphone starts dictation only on click. Text entry is first class. Keep the background textbook/page visually dominant.
CONCEPT A — PEARL GLASS. One polished interaction design board, landscape 1920x1200, neutral warm-white margins, showing THREE chronological states of the SAME tiny companion, left to right, as three aligned equal desktop crops. This is one coherent concept, not three design variants. Each crop contains the top-right corner of a realistic Mac desktop reading an open physics textbook titled "Conservation of energy", with its page extending left and below and a warm grey desktop visible at right. Each panel has the identical right inset and top anchor. Render the assistant at believable small proportions: first 300x45 logical points, second 320x155, third 320x290. Outside the desktop crops place small editorial state captions "Ready", "Ask", "Answer". No big marketing title.
READY: elegant horizontally elongated pill of translucent pearl-clear frosted glass, 22pt radius, subtle physical convex rim. Tiny folded V glyph at left, editable placeholder "Ask Vale…" in 13pt system type, mic icon and tiny ellipsis on right. No repeated "Vale" title taking space.
ASK: same surface has expanded downward into a rounded rectangle, continuous material and no gap/second bar; single thin top row V glyph, tiny "Vale", collapse chevron; compact selected-context chip "Textbook · p. 42" with small screen symbol and close x; question text "Why is kinetic energy squared?" wraps in the native text field. Bottom only plus and mic at left, dark small upward send button at right. Show generous 14pt internal insets but no vast whitespace.
ANSWER: top row tiny Vale mark/name and collapse; selected-context chip remains; question appears muted and concise; answer in readable 13pt text, line height 19pt: "Doubling speed takes four times the work. That's why kinetic energy grows with v²." Include a neatly typeset compact equation "Eₖ = ½mv²". Footer is a small single-line follow-up field "Ask a follow-up…" with plus and mic; no huge composer or status footer. Tiny copy and read-aloud icons next to answer can be subtle. Glass gently blurs the textbook behind it while a milkier text area preserves contrast. All visible labels must be crisp and correctly spelled. Refined Apple-native utility, feasible geometry, realistic restrained liquid glass.

CONCEPT B — SMOKE GLASS. One landscape 1920x1200 interaction design board showing THREE sequential states of the same compact assistant in three equal Mac desktop crops, aligned at top and right. Editorial captions outside the UI: "Ready", "Dictating", "Reply". This concept is a voice-led dark glass ribbon expanding into a tightly edited response slip. Background is a warm cream textbook about conservation of energy, in a real reading window, desktop in muted slate at right. It is daytime; dark translucent graphite Vale floats above the light page with excellent legibility. Product remains tiny, never dominates the page.
READY is exactly the intended slender 300x45pt pill footprint: tiny V mark, placeholder "Ask Vale…" that is clearly a text entry, simple microphone button at right, ellipsis at far right. Restrained charcoal translucent glass, 22pt radius, bright silver rim on upper left and muted lower edge, soft grounded shadow, no glowing border. No permanent voice waveform while idle.
DICTATING morphs the same panel to 300x116pt, same top/right anchor. Header "Listening…" with a small privacy mic indicator and square Stop control. A delicate horizontally centered monochrome waveform with a restrained pale lavender tint represents actual sound level, not a neon orb. Live transcript reads "Why is kinetic energy squared?" and fits in two lines. One compact selected context token "Textbook · p. 42". No second detached window. Typing alternative is a tiny keyboard icon.
REPLY morphs to 330x260pt. Header tiny V and Vale, collapse control at far right. Muted one-line question, readable light text answer: "Doubling speed takes four times the work. Kinetic energy therefore grows with v²." A restrained equation "Eₖ = ½mv²". Context token "Textbook · p. 42" stays visible. An understated bottom one-line follow-up input "Ask a follow-up…" with plus and mic. Include a small speaker icon near answer and optional quiet "Stop" only if speech is active. The panel is a single smoky physical glass object with blurred underlying shapes, crisp typography, no multiple bordered card layers. Ensure all app geometry would fit its stated compact points at normal macOS text sizes. Beautiful, calm and genuinely minimal.

CONCEPT C — READING LENS. One landscape 1920x1200 interaction design board, three aligned equal desktop crops with subtle neutral spacing. Distinct interaction structure: an input ribbon expands into a compact source-and-explanation annotation, with source visually tied to answer, rather than a conventional stacked chat thread. READY: a small elegant rounded rectangular input ribbon "Ask Vale…" with tiny V mark on left, plus and mic at right. Optical spacing, fine translucent border, almost invisible soft shadow. No titlebar.
WITH A SCREENSHOT: same single object expands down. Small top line "Vale" and collapse arrow. Under it a compact horizontal screenshot attachment 60x42pt containing a small textbook diagram; beside it short attachment name "Energy diagram" and "Screenshot" in smaller grey text, removable with x. The editable question "Explain this in simpler terms." below. Bottom line plus and mic at left and small dark send arrow at right. Do not invent upload progress or simultaneous listening.

No other assistant panels, no history rail, no interface made of floating cards. All exact copy crisp and readable. Sophisticated tiny Mac reading companion, no marketing treatment.
